tool_args.rationale: The data show both sink inhibition and a long-horizon reversal. Fit several explicit ways of coupling the sink to fast and slow adaptation, including a delayed slow response, and use fresh confirmation to test the best-fitting candidate. Confirmation has not yet established that this revision meets the tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both have already been acquired; the resulting eleven rows span short and long horizons and varying sink gradients.

considered_alternatives.option: Static siphon or uncoupled dual-exponential adaptation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A static law cannot explain the sign reversal, while an uncoupled temporal law omits the observed sink-gradient dependence.
Two submitted stationary variants failed confirmation, but the observations do not show chaotic sign oscillations and do not rule out other smooth sink-coupled mechanisms.
